Package com.egradx.notification.spi

Interface EgradxNotificationChannel

All Known Implementing Classes:
EgradxEmailChannel, EgradxLoggingChannel, EgradxProviderBackedChannel, EgradxSlackChannel, EgradxSmsChannel, EgradxWebhookChannel, EgradxWhatsAppChannel
public interface EgradxNotificationChannel
Delivers one rendered message to one address. Implement this, register it as a bean, and the channel is available: the library's own email channel is nothing more than this.

Contract for implementations:

  • Bound every network call with a timeout. send runs on a virtual thread and the dispatcher abandons it after egradx.notification.dispatcher.send-timeout, but a call that never returns still holds a provider connection until it does.
  • Expect to be called more than once for the same delivery. Delivery is at-least-once: an instance that crashes after the provider accepted a message but before the result was recorded will see that delivery retried. Pass EgradxDeliveryRequest.deliveryId() as an idempotency key where the provider supports one.
  • Classify failures — see EgradxDeliveryResult. Throwing is allowed and is treated as retryable.
  • Be thread-safe; many deliveries are sent concurrently.

The four default methods let a channel refuse bad input when a message is submitted, on the caller's thread, instead of discovering it in the background. Each defaults to accepting everything.

Exactly one bean may claim each channel(); two are a startup failure rather than a silent pick, since either choice would surprise someone.

    • unavailableFor

      default Optional<String> unavailableFor(UUID organizationId)
      Why this channel cannot send for organizationId right now — typically that nothing is configured for it — or empty if it can. Asked at submit time, so a caller learns "this organization has no email set up" immediately rather than from a DEAD delivery later.
      Parameters:
      organizationId - null for a platform-level message

    • validateAddress

      default void validateAddress(String address)
      Throws:
